shared_elements: repeated linear striations/hatching used as infill or to indicate multiple units
forms rendered against a plain ground
justification: A shows two highly schematic outline boats with upturned prow-and-stern extensions and a row of short vertical crew-strokes along the hull, stacked horizontally on a bare surface; B shows a naturalistic winged anthropomorphic figure in profile with beard, horned headdress, bracelets, patterned garment, detailed feathered wing, reaching toward a stylised rosette-bearing plant. The only overlap is the incidental use of repeated parallel strokes (crew marks versus feather/garment hatching), which is far too generic to indicate any shared iconography, and the modes of depiction — stick-schematic versus modelled relief — are opposite.
